name: adu-smart-campus-site
description: Abu Dhabi University Smart Digital Campus — PRE-BUILT static site. The repository root is the deployable artifact: index.html, assets/, images/, videos/ and api-data/ are already built and committed. Nothing needs installing or building to host this; point the web root at this directory and serve it. This file exists so that hosts which auto-detect a Node project (Hostinger, Netlify, Vercel, Render) find a no-op build here at the root instead of descending into src-app/ and running the source build, which writes to src-app/dist — a directory that is gitignored, is not served, and lacks the baked api-data the site needs.

scripts.build: node -e "const f=require('fs');if(!f.existsSync('index.html'))throw new Error('index.html is missing from the repository root - the committed build is incomplete');console.log('Nothing to build. This repository root IS the pre-built site; serve it as static files.')"
scripts.start: node -e "console.log('Static site. Serve the repository root with any web server; see README.md.')"
